author: S.E. Doster
description:
In 2019, Infinity Ward rebooted Call of Duty's Modern Warfare series, delivering a gritty and polished campaign featuring Captain Price and the assembly of the iconic Task Force 141. Despite the strong start, the series' sequels stumbled a bit, with  Modern Warfare 3 in particular standing out as having a weak story and open-world missions that missed the mark. But with Modern Warfare 4, Infinity Ward returns the series' campaign to strength with a satisfying narrative and well-crafted missions for an epic conclusion to the rebooted series.

Modern Warfare 4's single-player goes back to being a traditional and mostly linear experience that some recent entries have strayed from. There is only one open-world mission this year, and it is far more engaging than the previous attempts. Modern Warfare 4 doesn't introduce anything new or innovative, but it finds success with a consistently strong narrative and engaging gam
title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 Goes Back To Basic To Properly Finish Its Story

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is live in early access, with the full game arriving on October 23. Modern Warfare 4's single-player experience brings the epic story conclusion to Infinity Ward's rebooted Modern Warfare series. The Modern Warfare 4 campaign is slightly longer than recent Call of Duty games, and there are rewards you can unlock as you play. This guide will break down exactly what to expect for missions and rewards.

How long to beat the Modern Warfare 4 campaign?
title: How Long Is Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s Campaign?

author: Ben Janca
description: Sticking to the basics, Modern Warfare 4 delivers a satisfying campaign from start to finish.
title: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Review: A High Price For Revenge

author: Ben Janca
description:
ACT 1: Kokura Story Trailer
Trace the events that lead protagonist Makoto Daito to sneak aboard the trading merchant Orpheus’ ship bound for Japan, and the harsh realities that await in the first city he reaches: Kokura, Fukuoka.

More story trailers from each era are still to come. Follow Daito across five eras and five cities, from 1915 to 1965. As each era unfolds, you’ll discover the people and pivotal moments that will shape his fate. Stay tuned.

STRANGER THAN HEAVEN releases on January 15, 2027.
title: Stranger Than Heaven – Act 1: Kokura Story Overview Trailer

description:

Keep Diving!
title: Subnautica 2 – “The Voyage to Early Access 2 Begins” Overview Trailer

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
For the second year in a row, New York Comic Con served as a launching pad for a new Magic: The Gathering Universes Beyond expansion. While 2025's reveal focused on four teenage turtles, this year's panel revealed Marvel Darkhold Destiny, a deep dive into the more mystical elements of the Marvel universe. 

To learn more about the mechanics, monsters, and magic of this new Marvel set, we sat down with lead designer Mark Rosewater, narrative designer Dillon Deveney, art director Merideth Mulroney, and Marvel director of product development Jesse Falcon. We spoke about the right time to launch this new set, the brand-new character debuting in the cards and comics, and a returning mechanic that many old-school Magic fans haven't seen in decades.
title: “We Couldn’t Do This Right Out of the Gate”: MTG Team Talks Darkhold Destiny And Creating A New Marvel Character

author: Chris Pereira
description:
I was already looking forward to upcoming tactics game Australia Did It, but now I've got another reason to do so: a hilariously expanded new name.

In a fun turn of events, designer Rami Ismail has revealed a new subtitle has officially been adopted. Back in August, he posted a suggestion about the name that had been made as part of a localization report that turned out to be incredible.

"One localisation report for Australia Did It returned with a note that the game's title won't work in their territory & suggested to instead use 'Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defence Business' and now I want that, like, globally," he wrote at the time.
title: A Comically On-The-Nose New Title Has Me Even More Excited For This Upcoming Tactics Game

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The new Street Fighter movie features two big names from the wrestling world, with Roman Reigns playing Akuma alongside Cody Rhodes as Guile. Both WWE performers are video game fans, and Reigns says that's a hobby shared by many WWE stars backstage. Reigns added that video games have become the go-to downtime activity for the roster, rather than the "extracurricular" exploits of the previous generation of wrestlers.

"I'm not very good at it nowadays," Reigns said to ExtraTV (via
title: Street Fighter Star Roman Reigns Says Gaming Has Replaced Some Of Wrestling’s Old “Extracurricular” Activities

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
It's a big day for Call of Duty, as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable beginning today, October 16, for people who preorder the game.

The campaign is available to preload now, but doesn't unlock until 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET. You can play early across PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

Developer Infinity Ward issued a statement, asking people to please not spoil the story. "We've one one ask. Let everyone experience it for themselves. Keep the campaign spoilers under wraps," Infinity Ward said. "Time to go dark."
title: Call Of Duty: MW4’s Campaign Launches Today, Please Don’t Spoil It For Others

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Negative reviews for the new Street Fighter movie have prompted a video-game-movie veteran to speak up in defense of his previous works. The Boll is back.

German filmmaker Uwe Boll shared Variety's mixed review of Street Fighter on social media, adding: "Don't ever bash my movies again," seeming to imply that his own adaptations actually aren't that bad. Strong words from the man who achieved a 1% Rotten Tomatoes rating for his take on Alone in the Dark.

The top reply to Boll's post asks him to "shut the f**k up," calling him "trash," to which Boll replies: "That’s what they said when you were born," a comeback that would be more commonplace in an elementary school playground.
title: Master Of Cinema Uwe Boll Feels Vindicated By Bad Street Fighter Reviews

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker is already one of the best role-playing games of the year, but developer Rebel Wolves is preparing a big update that should make it even better. Like all good things in life, it starts with getting to pet a dog.

Update 1.1, which is scheduled to arrive next week, brings a number of new features to the game, including the ability to pet both dogs and cats via the game's directional system, which is currently only used for combat. It will also feature a new Story difficulty setting that provides "additional combat assist," new subtitle settings across all lines of dialogue, and most crucially, an item called Draught of Mind Rebirth.

The Draught of Mind Rebirth will allow you to forget all the skills and abilities you've acquired across the Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism trees. Not only will this give you the chance to reallocate your points in a way
title: The Blood Of Dawnwalker’s Next Update Will Let You Erase Your Mistakes And Pet The Dog

author: S.E. Doster
description:
After going hands-on with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 during the beta, we've curated some recommended settings for you to improve your aim and movement, as well as some important graphic settings to consider. This guide covers recommended settings for controllers, graphics, and audio settings in Modern Warfare 4.

Optimal settings are always going to be subjective, but here we detail our preferred options for console players on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Nintendo Switch 2 is also a platform choice this year, but our suggested settings won't do much to help the poor graphical performance of MW4 on Nintendo's handheld. However, there is a feature that lets you use the Joy-Cons for mouse controls, and you can remap buttons to your preference.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Switch 2.<
title: Best Settings For Modern Warfare 4 – Controller Layouts, Sensitivity, And More

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Citi, the investment bank and financial services company, has released a note about GTA 6 and Rockstar, and included in the brief is a line about what Rockstar could release next--a new Red Dead game.

The company said in its memo that, if Rockstar is telling the truth that GTA 6 did not in fact cost $1.5 billion to make, then the studio may be able to get a new Red Dead game out sooner than anyone might have imagined.
title: Next Red Dead Launching By 2027 Or 2028 “May Not Be Unreasonable,” Bank Says, But It Definitely Is

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
For decades, if you wanted to play Call of Duty or Halo, you needed a console or a PC with decent hardware. But recently, a flood of vibe-coded games has been appearing online. What's happening here? It turns out that recent AI updates--like the release of Claude Opus 5.5--are making it very easy to reverse-engineer the source code for a game and get it running in a browser. So far, retro games from the 2000s and early 2010s are making the rounds, and if you're wondering just what the heck is going on, you can read our breakdown of why video game publishers are sweating buckets right now.

What are vibe-coded browser ports?

title: Why Do Big Games Keep Being Made Playable In Browsers? A Guide To Vibe-Coded Ports
